bioAdditions: FamilySearch makes Christopher Bittenbender (1721-1805) of Williams Twp and Easton the second husband of Maria Elisabetha (Christmann) Grub. He emigrated in 1744 and first married at New Hanover in 1749. His first wife died on 7 May 1792, and he married the widow Grub, who had lost Andreas in Aug 1792, in about 1795 (S1). He and the Grubs belonged to the same congregation: 'Christoph Buttenbender' and 'Andreas Grub, w. Maria Elisabeth' both appear in its communicant list (S2). He died at Easton on 19 Jul 1805. His will of 3 Mar 1803 is in Northampton Will Book 4 p.219 and would show whether he provided for Maria Elisabetha (S1).
